translations.en: Document the situation with photos from multiple angles. Record location, time, and number of people affected.
translations.bi: Dokumentem situation wetem foto long different saed. Rekod ples, taem, mo namba blong man we oli afekted.
translations.tpi: Raitim situation wetem piksa long ol kain ples. Raitim ples, taim, na namba bilong manmeri i afektim.
translations.ht: Dokimante sitiyasyon an ak foto soti nan plizyè ang. Anrejistre kote, lè, ak kantite moun ki afekte.

translations.en: Report to coordination center with all available details. Await further instructions from emergency coordinator.
translations.bi: Reportem long koordinasen senta wetem olgeta informesen. Wet long moa instraksens from koordineta.
translations.tpi: Ripotim long koordinesen senta long ol samting yu save. Wet long moa toktok bilong koordineta.
translations.ht: Rapòte nan sant kòdinasyon an ak tout detay disponib. Tann enstriksyon anplis nan kòdonatè ijans lan.

translations.en: Ensure your own safety first. Do not enter any area that appears unstable or hazardous without proper equipment.
translations.bi: Mekem sua fastaem se yu seif. No go insaed long eni eria we hemi luk unstable oa denjeres without proper equipment.
translations.tpi: Lukautim yu yet pastaim. No go insait long eni ples i luk no sef o denja without rait ekwipmen.
translations.ht: Asire sekirite pwòp ou an an premye. Pa antre nan nenpòt zòn ki parèt enstab oswa danjere san ekipman apwopriye.
